title: Injection document (instance contract v0, IF-6)
description: The one JSON document the orchestrator writes on the standard input of the one-shot injector. Contains secrets (flags, seed): never put it in an environment variable, a log, a label or a file outside the memory-backed volumes. Rules a schema cannot express (duplicate challenge keys, decoy equal to a flag, duplicate decoy index) are checked by scripts/validate-contracts.mjs.

schema_version.description: Contract version this document follows, 0.x until v1.0.0.

instance_id.description: Proposal: i- plus 16 Base32 characters (to confirm).

epoch.description: Flag epoch of this instance, starts at 1 and grows by one on every reset.

issued_at.description: Optional. When the orchestrator wrote the document (UTC). Information only in v0: the injector does not reject old documents; a stale document is detected by its epoch.

seed.description: Random per-instance seed for seeded accounts and data. A secret like the flags.

decoy_placement.description: Optional. Where the decoy goes. Field name proposed, content to be defined by the target stream (T).

flag.description: VM{ plus 24 Base32 characters }. Format from architecture 04 section 11.1.
